source_title: 田中の着膨れしない暴漢対策
curator_title: 田中の着膨れしない暴漢対策
opening: After being mugged, a company president avoided carrying large sums of cash. An unavoidable situation made him put one million yen in a bag. Worried that criminals would attack if they discovered it contained one million yen, he added more cash. Why?
solution: Kidnappers demanded fifty million yen for his daughter. To save money, he prepared bundles largely made of blank paper, with real notes on their outer faces: only one million yen was genuine. He feared violence if the deception was discovered. He replaced the top bundles with genuine banknotes, increasing the actual cash so a superficial inspection would be less likely to expose the fake ransom.

rubric.criterion: Past mugging explains usual avoidance of large cash; daughter's kidnapping creates need to carry ransom.
Demand is much greater than one million: dummy paper bundles with real notes on outside create apparent full ransom while actual cash is one million.
He fears violence if kidnappers discover the shortfall/deception; replaces top bundles with real notes to make inspection less revealing, hence increases cash.
